local.note: Dybeck's text and the traditional folk melody are both long out of copyright.

english.author: Government of Sweden
english.note: The Swedish government's own English rendering, supplied for public use. Recorded here because a translation carries its own rights even when the original is free — see readme-anthems.md.

local: Du gamla, Du fria, Du fjällhöga [[nord]],
Jag hälsar Dig, vänaste land uppå jord,
Din sol, Din himmel, Dina ängder gröna.
Din sol, Din himmel, Dina ängder gröna.
english: You old, you free, you high mountain [[North]]
I greet you, friendliest land upon Earth,
Your sun, your sky, your countryside green.
Your sun, your sky, your countryside green.

local: Du tronar på minnen från fornstora dar,
då ärat Ditt namn flög över jorden.
Jag vet att Du är och Du blir vad Du var.
Ja, jag vill leva jag vill dö i [[Norden]].
Ja, jag vill leva jag vill dö i [[Norden]].
english: You sit enthroned upon memories of ancient great places,
When your name flew over the Earth in glory,
I know that you are, and you will be what you were,
Yes, I want to live, I want to die in [[the North]].
Yes, I want to live, I want to die in [[the North]].
